title: THE LOADOUT QUESTION FITS ITS BUTTONS
why: Seen on the 4K ascent screenshot of 2026-10-08: the WHAT ARE YOU TAKING UP card held five choices in a fixed 560 pixel card, so RANDOM FROM STASH broke over three lines and MY LOADOUT over two. The card now grows to fit its buttons on one line, never narrower than before, with its words kept to the old width; a plain yes or no question looks as it did.
now: Every choice on the WHAT ARE YOU TAKING UP card sits on one line.
